meta.text: On Databricks, your remedies come in three tiers. First, run OPTIMIZE to compact on demand. Second, enable auto compaction and optimized writes so the platform handles it as writes land. Third — and this is the exam favorite — on Unity Catalog managed tables, predictive optimization does this automatically. So before you schedule a manual run, ask whether the table is already managed and covered. Remember the interplay: aggressive partitioning amplifies small files, so compaction strategy and partition design must be reasoned about together. On the next page we will check your understanding of exactly these trade-offs.
